preconditions.description: The number of vertices (n) and edges (m) are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n and a_i != b_i for a_i, b_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge (a_i, b_i) has valid vertex indices and is not a self-loop.

postconditions.description: The number of selected vertices (k) is positive and does not exceed the total number of vertices.
The number of selected vertices matches the printed count (k).

postconditions.expression: all(x in range(1, n+1) for x in selected_vertices)
postconditions.description: All selected vertices are within the valid vertex range.

postconditions.expression: all(not (x in selected_vertices and y in selected_vertices) for x, y in edges)
postconditions.description: No two selected vertices are directly connected by an edge.

postconditions.expression: all(any((x in selected_vertices and y in neighbors[x]) or (any(z in selected_vertices for z in neighbors[x]) and y in neighbors[z]) for x in range(1, n+1)) for y in range(1, n+1) if y not in selected_vertices)
postconditions.description: Every unselected vertex is reachable from some selected vertex in at most two moves.
